title: Procedural SVG Animation Patterns
description: Deterministic standalone SVG motion mechanisms and reusable combinations.

families.title: Timing systems
families.description: Phase, stagger, easing, clocks, springs, and state sequencing as reusable temporal control signals.

families.title: Transform mechanics
families.description: Nested translation, rotation, scale, articulated linkage, and parallax assembled into kinematic systems.

families.title: Path choreography
families.description: Stroke drawing, dash transport, motion paths, topology-safe morphs, trim windows, and authored traces.

families.title: Parametric geometry
families.description: Curves generated from equations and animated by changing phase, frequency, radius, or coefficient sets.

families.title: Fields and sampling
families.description: Vector, scalar, distance, and noise fields converted into arrows, streamlines, ribbons, particles, and contours.

families.title: Simulation systems
families.description: Local rules and numerical integration for flocking, constraints, coupled springs, automata, and diffusion.

families.title: Recursive growth
families.description: Rewriting systems, accumulation, branching, aggregation, and attraction models that reveal structure over time.

families.title: Tiling and symmetry
families.description: Repeatable cells, interference, tessellation, mirrored sectors, relaxation, and quasiperiodic sampling.

families.title: Paint and compositing
families.description: Animated gradients, masks, clips, filter graphs, displacement, morphology, blur, and light sweeps.

families.title: Hybrid compositions
families.description: Reusable combinations that couple two or more temporal, geometric, simulation, and paint systems.
